card.name: Digits inside phone and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit or hyphen partway through a phone number, ISBN, ISSN or DOI string. It is strongest in the middle of the number, before the remaining digits.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: Hyphen or digit inside a toll-free or contact phone number.

modes.label: ISBN/ISSN codes
modes.description: A digit inside a book or journal identifier in a citation.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of phone numbers and book or journal ID numbers, while the number is still being written out.
